top_findings.title: Competition filter does not normalize the extended dataset's top-flight label — Brasileirão 2023+ silently empty
top_findings.evidence: src/soccer-data.ts:37 stores BR-Football-Dataset.csv competition = r.tournament verbatim ('Serie A' etc.); only source of 2023 top-flight (1088 rows). findMatches filter (soccer-data.ts:47) substring-matches 'brasileirão' which never matches 'Serie A'. Agent's own test teamStatistics('Palmeiras',{season:2023,competition:'Brasileirão'}) asserts matches>0 and FAILS.
top_findings.suggestion: Map 'Serie A'/'Serie B'/'Serie C' to canonical competition labels or normalize competition names in findMatches.

top_findings.title: 'calculates a record and a head-to-head comparison' fails (Brasileirão 2023 returns 0 matches)
top_findings.evidence: src/soccer-data.test.ts:27-29; re-ran npm test in temp copy: 5 tests, 4 pass, 1 fail (AssertionError record.matches>0). Matches stored test_coverage=0.8.
